page: Microsoft Azure E128-64s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv6 server family. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor with x86_64 architecture, it features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core density of 16.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, relying instead on external Premium Storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core processing and top-tier memory performance. The server achieved a top-tier rating in uncached memory read and write bandwidth, reaching 391.59 GB/sec and 171.9 GB/sec respectively. Multi-core performance is robust, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 20700.0 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 63834.72. Database operations are highly efficient, as demonstrated by a top-tier Passmark database score of 35230.63 and a strong Redis SET throughput of 85.44 million operations per second. Additionally, static web serving throughput reached a top-tier 94.28 GB/sec.

Given its massive 1 TB memory capacity and high memory bandwidth, the E128-64s_v6 is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads such as large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise resource planning systems. The inclusion of Intel Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions supports accelerated mathematical and AI inference tasks, reflected in strong medium-model LLM prompt processing speeds of 275.52 tokens/sec. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPUs represents a tradeoff, making it less suitable for local-storage-heavy scratch space workloads or GPU-accelerated deep learning training.
description: The Microsoft Azure E128-64s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Esv6 family, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C x86_64 processor with 64 vCPUs (32 physical cores) operating at 4.2 GHz, backed by 260 MB of L3 cache and 1024.0 GB of RAM. While it lacks local storage and GPUs, it supports Premium Storage. Benchmarks show top-tier memory bandwidth, with uncached read speeds of 391.59 GB/sec and write speeds of 171.9 GB/sec, alongside strong multi-core performance. It excels in memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and in-memory caching, supported by advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX.
